wikidot5e:feat:agent-of-order-ua.effectSummary: Increase one ability score by 1, maximum 20. Once per turn when you damage a visible creature within 60 feet, you may deal an extra 1d8 force damage and force a Wisdom save against DC 8 + proficiency bonus + the modifier of the ability score increased by this feat. On a failure, spectral bindings restrain the target until the start of your next turn. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.

wikidot5e:feat:alchemist.effectSummary: Increase Intelligence by 1, maximum 20. Gain proficiency with alchemist's supplies, or expertise with them if already proficient. As an action, identify a visible potion within 5 feet as though tasting it. During a short rest while you have alchemist's supplies and a potion of healing within reach, you can enhance one such potion of any rarity; if consumed within 1 hour after the rest, the drinker may take the potion's maximum possible healing instead of rolling its healing dice.

wikidot5e:feat:alert.effectSummary: While conscious, you cannot be surprised. Gain +5 to initiative. Other creatures do not gain advantage on attacks against you solely because they are unseen by you.

wikidot5e:feat:animal-handler.effectSummary: Increase Wisdom by 1, maximum 20. Gain Animal Handling proficiency, or expertise if already proficient. As a bonus action, command one friendly beast within 60 feet that can hear you and is not following someone else's command; choose its next action and movement or give a general command lasting up to 1 minute.

wikidot5e:feat:arcanist.effectSummary: Increase Intelligence by 1, maximum 20. Gain Arcana proficiency, or expertise if already proficient. Learn prestidigitation and detect magic; you can cast detect magic once without a spell slot per long rest.

wikidot5e:feat:artificer-initiate.effectSummary: Learn one artificer cantrip and one 1st-level artificer spell, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability. Cast the 1st-level spell once without a slot per long rest and also with any appropriate spell slots you have. Gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools, and you may use that tool type as a spellcasting focus for spells you cast using Intelligence.

wikidot5e:feat:athlete.effectSummary: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1, maximum 20. Standing from prone costs only 5 feet of movement, climbing costs no extra movement, and you need only a 5-foot run-up rather than 10 feet for running long or high jumps.

wikidot5e:feat:baleful-scion.effectSummary: Increase one ability score by 1, maximum 20. Once per turn when you damage a visible creature within 60 feet, you may deal additional necrotic damage equal to 1d6 + your proficiency bonus and regain HP equal to the necrotic damage dealt. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.

wikidot5e:feat:baleful-scion-ua.effectSummary: Increase one ability score by 1, maximum 20. Once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon attack, you may deal extra necrotic damage equal to 1d6 + your proficiency bonus and regain HP equal to that necrotic damage. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.

wikidot5e:feat:barbed-hide.effectSummary: Increase Constitution or Charisma by 1, maximum 20. Gain Intimidation proficiency, or expertise if already proficient. As a bonus action, extend or retract body barbs. At the start of each of your turns while extended, deal 1d6 piercing damage to every creature grappling you or grappled by you.
